title: The Firefly Who Saved His Glow

chapters.title: The Firefly Who Saved His Glow

pages.text: When evening came to the meadow, the fireflies blinked on like tiny lanterns. One little Firefly loved his glow so much, he never wanted to turn it off.
"Time to rest your light," called his mama, as the moon rose round and white. "Not yet!" said Firefly. "I want to glow ALL night!"
So he glowed. He glowed past the owl's first hoot. He glowed past the crickets' last song.
He glowed and glowed... until his little light grew dim... and dimmer... and by morning, it was the tiniest flicker you ever saw.
That evening, all his friends lit up the meadow like floating stars. But Firefly's glow was too tired to shine. He sat on a leaf in the almost-dark, and his mama sat beside him.
"Lights need rest," she said gently, "so they can be bright."
So Firefly rested. He tucked his wings, closed his eyes, and slept the whole soft night.
And the next evening — oh! He lit up first and brightest of all, a little golden star above the grass.
Rest isn't the end of your glow. Rest is where your glow comes from.
Y colorín colorado, este cuento se ha acabado.
